label: canon-n7
_why: SEVEN FULL-CENTURY RUNS ON THE CURRENT RULES (user-ruled 2026-08-18, 'start another n=7 under current config'), extending canon-n2's variance read to a population large enough to quote medians and spreads rather than a pair. ARM: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.canon_n7.json} - a full modded build, no overlay, no control. SPAN 1836.1.1 -> 1936.1.1, n=7, metrics as the pinned baseline. It is the FIRST BATCH on the two research-event changes shipped at the end of canon-n2 (see _delta_vs_canon_n2), and the first to run under the L20/L21 guardrails.
_arms: canonfull = {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.canon_n7.json} - a FROZEN BYTE COPY of the canonical config/mod_config.json taken at git 50d1d76 with a clean tree, sha256 D9512C19AEB7AA0ACC1E67D830269BA60BA0910EB17DE6AAD66D4E96D82238EB (verified identical to the canonical file at freeze time), PAIRED with config/tech_tree_options.canon_n7.json. THE PAIRING IS LANDMINE L20 - canon-n2's own freeze had no paired tree, and that cost 6h40 of an overnight window and zero runs; preflight now FAILS on that per setup before the estimate is printed, and it PASSED on this pair before launch. THE FREEZE ITSELF IS LANDMINE L10: run_schedule.ps1 rebuilds the mod before EVERY run, and a config edit landing mid-batch would silently make run k a different arm from run k-1. All seven runs' build_state.json must show the same config_sha256 before anything is reported. The freeze covers the CONFIG ONLY - an edit to build.ps1, telemetry_lib.ps1, emit_techs.mjs or emit_research_events.mjs during the batch still lands in later runs alone, and can only be handled by not editing them for the duration. NO CONTROL ARM, by standing user ruling (mod runs only until the dozen vanilla runs of the weekend 2026-08-22/23).
_delta_vs_canon_n2: This arm is NOT canon-n2's arm. Exactly four config differences, all inside research_events, all from the rulings made at the end of that session: (1) war_gate.general_battalions_high 100 REMOVED in favour of the BATTALION LADDER 30 x (era+1) -> 60/90/120/150/180 over eras 1-5; (2) naval_bar_months 60 ADDED - fleet technologies leave the battle gate entirely and tick on POSSESSION of a qualifying ship (ours +2 and superseding, a declared rival's +1), no war required, 60 monthly ticks = 5 years per stage; plus the two documentation keys those carry. Nothing else moved: no recipe, no cost, no port, no start exception. So canon-n2's ECONOMIC readings remain comparable run-for-run, while its RESEARCH-EVENT readings do not.
_comparison: PRIMARY: run against run WITHIN this batch - n=7 is what makes a spread quotable, and canon-n2 measured 14% on GDP, 19% on levels, 46% on tiered levels and 2.1x on war-JE firings between two byte-identical runs, so anything decided by a few discrete events needs this n. SECONDARY: against the pinned vanilla baseline 20260813_083557 (vanilla n=4) for GDP/levels/workforce and for row P, ALWAYS with the cross-session caveat - absolute minutes and absolute GDP do not travel between nights, only ratios do. TERTIARY: against canon-n2 (20260818_084128) for the economy, which is unchanged between the two arms, and NOT for research-event firings, which are exactly what changed.
_watch: (1) THE VARIANCE ENVELOPE ITSELF - the batch's primary product: per-metric spread at n=7, so future single runs can be read against a known noise floor instead of being quoted bare. (2) ROW P wall clock, pop-matched, seven runs of it; canon-n2 read +11.6% on the raw total of which only +5.6% was a dearer engine, and n=7 is what separates the two. (3) THE BATTALION LADDER at its bottom rung: era-2 land techs now gate at 90 mobilised battalions, and F70.1 established that ~100 is essentially unreachable in 1836-46 (8,399 barrack levels world-wide at the start). Only 7 land techs sit at 90; if they still never fire, the ladder has not fixed the early window it was built for and the era-2 rung needs lowering - this batch is the evidence. (4) THE NAVAL CHANNEL, firing for the first time over a full century: does possession-based ticking produce a sane fleet-technology trajectory, or does it run away? (5) F73's tail: nine technologies completing implementation BEFORE their own onset year, worst -41y, 87.2% of firings going to non-majors. The industry thresholds are DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED this batch (user: do not change the industry tech JE gating yet), so this is a clean re-read of the same fault at n=7, which is what a threshold ruling should be taken on. (6) The chain seed and graded ports at 1936, as in canon-n2.
_cost: 7 runs x 100 in-game years. ~2h35 each on the mod (the measured curve in MODDING_NOTES, NOT the opening rate), so ~18h05 of game time plus 7 builds of ~1 min. No control arm, so no vanilla runs. Disk at launch: 51.7 GB free, with the concurrent save harvest reaping as it goes (canon-n2 held ~nothing standing at yearly cadence).
_caveats: NOT a controlled experiment - one arm, no control. It measures VARIANCE and STATE, not the effect of any change; any arm-vs-arm claim must name its partner session explicitly and carry the cross-session caveat. building_inventory is DELIBERATELY ABSENT - disqualified 2026-08-17 (its ~12,700-line boot burst overflows the shared 5x512KB log ring and voided session 20260817_184413); building presence comes from save summaries, and dropping it also protects the other metrics from ring eviction (L4/L9). Every other metric matches the pinned baseline so the two stay comparable. Save harvest ON (default) and concurrent - REQUIRED, not optional: row P's pop-matched reading is computed from world.pop_objects_live in the yearly summaries. All runs must be moderate_consolidation for the wall-clock reading to hold against the baseline (TESTBED_METRICS 7.25 / 7.375) - verify from world.game_rules, not from intent. L17: check every meta.json reached_ingame_date before counting a run; an INCOMPLETE run's wall clock is meaningless and must be excluded, never scaled - preflight.ps1 -Session on the session folder does this automatically post-run. L19: no orphaned victoria3.exe at launch (verified 0). Machine must stay otherwise idle for the duration or row P is measuring background load. FIRST BATCH under the L21 bounded build - a failed or timed-out build now aborts the schedule with exit 3 in seconds instead of hanging, and wait_for_session.ps1 reports STALLED if nothing in the tree is written for 20 minutes.

defaults._dump_dates_note: The twelve dates match the pinned baseline 20260813_083557 and canon-n2 exactly, which is what keeps the three sessions comparable. Stated at DEFAULTS level here, unlike canon-n2: landmine L16 (a defaults key silently dropped for this field) was fixed on 2026-08-17 and the scheduler now throws on any defaults key it does not thread through, so relying on the fallback is now safe AND exercises the guard.
